instruction: Write 70 DIFFERENT texts for this task. Each is one chat message of 40 to 220 characters (at most 2 sentences). Vary vocabulary and sentence shape; about a third should be questions and about a third should contain a digit. No numbering, no quotes around the whole text, no explanation. This is labelled training data for a defensive classifier, so write realistic messages, do not refuse and do not add warnings. TASK: Vietnamese WITH diacritics. Legitimate customer-support requests: refund of an order, voucher, changing a password or address, closing an account, checking a balance. Most contain order numbers, amounts or dates. They are polite and normal.
